coordinate_policy: Coordinates are modern identification aids only. They must never be interpreted as exact historical positions unless historical_match says otherwise. Unresolved narrative sites retain null coordinates.

locations.name: Sekigahara
locations.map_note: Narrative opening: battlefield region.

locations.name: Mount Ibuki
locations.map_note: The novel uses the surrounding mountain area, not a precise summit position.

locations.name: Tarui
locations.map_note: Named as the direction of travel in chapter 1; arrival is not explicitly established there.

locations.name: Oko and Akemi's House
locations.map_note: House in the Ibuki foothills; exact modern site unresolved.

locations.name: Miyamoto
locations.map_note: Home settlement and principal setting of chapters 3–7.

locations.name: Aida River
locations.map_note: Runs through the Miyamoto area and is used as a route landmark.

locations.name: Mimasaka Highroad
locations.map_note: Major road through the Miyamoto region.

locations.name: Shippoji
locations.map_note: Miyamoto-area temple and recurring narrative hub.

locations.name: Ogin's House
locations.map_note: House built by Munisai overlooking the river.

locations.name: Hon'den House
locations.map_note: Osugi's family residence across the river from the Shimmen residence.

locations.name: Sanumo Mountains
locations.map_note: Mountain refuge used by Takezo during the pursuit.

locations.name: Tsujinohara
locations.map_note: Mountain area passed by Takuan and Otsu en route to Itadori Pasture.

locations.name: Itadori Pasture
locations.map_note: Pasture on the mountain where Takuan and Otsu camp and capture Takezo.

locations.name: Old Cryptomeria at Shippoji
locations.map_note: Tree in the Shippoji grounds; exact modern tree/site not asserted.

locations.name: Nakayama Pass
locations.map_note: Narrative mountain pass where Musashi and Otsu separate.

locations.name: Mikazuki Teahouse
locations.map_note: Roadside teahouse where Otsu becomes ill and is later pursued by Osugi and Gonroku.

locations.name: Shingu
locations.map_note: Mentioned as the intended overnight stop after the Mikazuki Teahouse.

locations.name: Hinagura
locations.map_note: Provincial-border area containing the stockade where Ogin is believed to be held.

locations.name: Hinagura Stockade
locations.map_note: Fortified prison complex attacked by Musashi.

locations.name: Himeji
locations.map_note: Castle town and destination after Hinagura.

locations.name: Hanada Bridge
locations.map_note: Reader-facing literary landmark; modern identification is kept separate from the historical claim.

locations.name: Himeji Castle
locations.map_note: Narrative destination and site of Musashi's three-year confinement.

locations.name: Sayo District
locations.map_note: Location of Ogin's later residence according to Takuan's report in chapter 8.

locations.name: Harima Road Teahouse
locations.map_note: Retained as an unresolved roadside site; the chapter 7 teahouse is specifically identified as Mikazuki.
